changelog: SIP endpoint-aware trunks and internal IPs
Trunks and the internal IP Directory can now distinguish multiple services on the same SBC IP by SIP port, such as `10.0.0.1:5060` and `10.0.0.1:5070`.
Omitting the port means SIP port 5060, preserving a simple default while preventing that rule from matching a different port.
changelog_es: Trunks and internal IP labels can distinguish multiple SIP services on the same IP by port (`IP:port`, `CIDR:port` or `[IPv6]:port`).
Calls and CDRs now retain observed caller/callee SIP ports and expose the matched carrier port as additive fields.
